votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of May 16, 2023, and May 25, 2023, as well as the formal meeting minutes of May 16, 2023.
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from the May 16, 2023 work session, May 25, 2023 work session, and May 16, 2023 formal meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer item B-1 (Grant Application: Plug-In Electric Vehicle Make-Ready Project Funding) to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a grant application from the Division of Energy and Environment to Rocky Mountain Power for EV charging infrastructure at four Westside locations, referring it to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ordinance: 1782 South 1600 East Zoning Map and Master Plan Amendment to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone of 1782 South 1600 East from R-1/7000 to SR-3 and a Sugar House Master Plan amendment, deferring action to a later date.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Capital Improvement Program Projects resolution to August 8.
votes.description: The Council continued the public hearing on FY2024 Capital Improvement Program project funding allocations to the August 8, 2023 meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance (40) of 2023 Rezone at Approximately 1350, 1358, and 1370 South West Temple, with the condition that the petitioner enter a development agreement including minimum ground floor retail use requirements and 10% affordable dwelling units at 80% AMI for at least fifteen years.
votes.description: The Council rezoned three properties at 1350, 1358, and 1370 South West Temple from RB to TSA-UC-C to facilitate a mixed-use redevelopment, subject to a development agreement requiring ground-floor commercial activation and affordable housing set-asides.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance (41) of 2023 Zoning Map and Master Plan Amendments at Riverside Cottages.
votes.description: The Council approved rezoning portions of properties at 1500, 1516, 1520, and 1522 West 500 North and 552 North 1500 West from R-1/7,000 to R-1/5,000 and SR-3, along with a Northwest Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map amendment, to accommodate a future redevelopment proposal.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance (42) of 2023 Rezone at 1549 South, 1551 South, 1565 South 1000 West, and 1574 South 900 West.
votes.description: The Council approved rezoning properties at 1549, 1551, and 1565 South 1000 West and 1574 South 900 West from R-1/7,000 to RMF-30 to allow the development of townhouses.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance (43) of 2023 Rezone at Approximately 510 South 200 West.
votes.description: The Council approved rezoning the property at 510 South 200 West from D-2 (Downtown Support District) to D-1 (Central Business District).

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance (44) of 2023 Nonconforming Signs, and adopt a legislative action initiating a petition to review electronic sign standards to comply with changes to federal and state law.
votes.description: The Council approved an ordinance amending Title 21A regarding nonconforming signs to provide more flexibility for maintenance and modification, and initiated a legislative action to review electronic sign standards for brightness, animation, and other concerns.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution (21) of 2023 authorizing Addendum Number 7 to the Interlocal Agreement with the Utah Transit Authority.
votes.description: The Council authorized the Mayor to enter into Addendum No. 7 to the 20-year Interlocal Agreement with UTA to implement 2023-24 Frequent Transit Network service on routes along 200 South, 900 South, 2100 South, and 1000 North/South Temple.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution (22) of 2023, Community Renewable Energy Program Utility Agreement.
votes.description: The Council approved a resolution authorizing the City's ongoing participation in developing a community renewable energy program through a utility agreement.

The Council approved the full consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for three ordinances and approving four board appointments (Emina Alibegovic and Justin Neville to the Police Civilian Review Board, Anne Olsen to the Business Advisory Board, and Spencer Lawson to the Cultural Core Finance Committee).
